summary: Verified all iteration-28 admin/member flows: Report This Clip (member UI + backend), Blocked Words editor (admin UI + backend), Trial Abuse view (admin UI + backend, block→402→unblock→200), plus regressions (auth/me, caption-search, landing images). 11/11 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend admin sections render (23 blocked-word chips, seeded trial device, hidden clips, clip reports). Member Report Clip flow verified end-to-end: reasons panel appears, cancel hides it, clicking a reason posts to /api/caption-search/report, toast "Thanks — we'll review this clip." shown, and the clip is removed from the current list.
action_items: None from testing — feature is production ready.

Minor: the review request refers to a caption-search-modal wrapper, but the Real Speakers UI is actually rendered inline via data-testid=real-speakers-inline (no separate modal wrapper); the report button, reasons panel, cancel and reasons all work as spec'd inside the inline card. Documentation could be updated to reflect this — no code change needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/admin/blocked-words accepts a full replacement list `{words: [...]}` — not partial add/remove. UI already handles this correctly by re-sending the full list after mutating locally; consistent, but note that concurrent edits by two admins could clobber each other (last-write-wins). Acceptable for a small admin team.

The blocked-words rescan of ~4361 transcripts runs synchronously on the POST call and can occupy the event loop for several seconds; consider offloading to a background task and returning 202 with a job id if list is large.

The backend startup ingest supervisor triggers on every hot-reload and blocks the API for ~60–90s each restart while iterating channels. Consider gating startup ingest behind a flag or delaying it a few seconds after startup so hot-reloads don't take the API offline.
Report reason testids are derived from the label string (replace non-a-z), so localising labels would silently break selectors — consider decoupling id from label.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (admin sections render + blocked-words + trial device toggle + member report clip)

rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only note: the initial pytest run failed because the test file lived under /app/backend/tests (a watched dir) and every edit caused the reloader to restart the API mid-run, which combined with the ~60s startup ingest looked like a system-wide outage. Solved by restarting via supervisorctl and pausing 90s between edits and test runs.
